scope: LibreCAD_3 preserve symbolic default layer lineweight across import, edit and export
finding: A generated R12 layer with absent group 370 imported as explicit 0 mm and losslessly saving the same profile was incorrectly reported as a lossy layer-lineweight conversion. The adapter also could not retain the difference between DEFAULT and explicit 0.25 mm.
change: Store a separate default-lineweight state on Layer; preserve the existing five-argument constructor and add a six-argument overload. Carry the state through the layer builder, importer and writer; the initial display fallback is 0.25 mm. The layer editor exposes Default separately from fixed widths and preserves the state on rename and frozen-state changes. Selecting a fixed width clears default intent.

verification.red: Before the fix, the locally generated AC1009 source imported its absent layer width as 0 rather than 0.25 mm and legacy saves reported loss.
verification.persistence: PASS: 6 focused tests each for installed ABI-3 shared and pinned 2.0 static codecs on macOS ARM64, plus 4 adjacent save/roundtrip tests each. Checks include R12/R14/R2000 ASCII and binary exports and readback, explicit/custom entity and layer losses, corrected retries, and default vs explicit 0.25 mm. An ASCII tag scan separately confirms group 370 values -3 and 25. Scratch drawings were created from scratch and were not committed.
verification.ui: PASS: clean LibreCAD_3 Release GUI build with installed shared ABI-3, after explicitly selecting matching Homebrew Lua headers and library. Two focused offscreen Qt tests exercise default/explicit changes in both directions, frozen preservation, and rename. The test binary reused the clean GUI object files; it is not a full GUI suite or native rendering qualification.

limits: Local candidate is unmerged and requires all preceding ordered LibreCAD_3 patches, including the custom layer- and entity-width patches; apply this patch with git apply --unidiff-zero. The 0.25 mm display fallback is the documented initial value, not a live implementation of the user-configurable LWDEFAULT setting. Full native GUI interaction, package installation, other platforms, unsupported layer-lineweight input states and complete consumer/source-graph qualification remain open. Layer object layout changes require rebuilding LibreCAD_3 and dependent code.
